meta.title: presentation-md — product pitch
meta.description: Product pitch for presentation-md, the Deck JSON sibling of the Hallmark experiment page: agents write typed Deck JSON that renders HTML, native PowerPoint and a share link, with craft gates on every render. Every number is a product fact; there are no invented metrics.

slides.heading: Agents write the deck. You can still edit it.
slides.lead: Typed Deck JSON in. HTML, PowerPoint and a share link out.
slides.notes: Say the purpose sentence, then stop. The next slide earns the problem.

slides.heading: Agent-made slides look sharp once, then break on the first edit
slides.lead: Teams regenerate the whole deck to fix one slide. Fonts drift and the PowerPoint export fails.

slides.heading: One typed file renders HTML, native PowerPoint and a share link
slides.body:
The agent fills typed slide beats.
Craft gates flag weak slides before you see them.
Change one field and re-render that slide alone.

slides.lead: Schema errors fail fast. The judge scores headings, density and rhythm.

slides.heading: One install command puts it in six agent setups

slides.quote: Use Hallmark for the site. Use presentation-md for the deck.
slides.by: The one-line version of this pitch

slides.heading: Slide editors and page skills leave the agent's deck unchecked
slides.left:
Built for clicks or for web pages
AI output is a one-way draft
No gate before the room sees it
slides.right:
Built for agents, through MCP
Every edit stays in typed JSON
Audit and judge gate each render
slides.notes: Name the gap in one breath, then point at the right column.

slides.heading: PowerPoint export keeps every visible word as editable text
slides.body:
Native shapes, charts and tables, not screenshots.
A fidelity report lists what PowerPoint will change.
Office-safe fonts look the same on every machine.
slides.aside: A CI scorecard fails the build if any text on an HTML slide is missing from its PowerPoint twin.
